notes: Stripe webhook delivery uses HTTP POST to the configured endpoint; no auth required in the request itself as signature verification is done via headers.
The webhook payload includes the charge ID and customer ID needed for mapping.
Idempotency for outbound requests is handled via the Idempotency-Key header on Mailchimp calls, not inbound webhook.
Endpoint returns tags for a subscriber; used to check if tag already exists before adding.
Requires list_id and subscriber_hash (MD5 of lowercase email) as path parameters.
Pagination is not applicable as this endpoint does not support pagination; returns all tags in one response.
Bearer token authentication using Mailchimp API key.
Adds or removes tags from a list member; if tag does not exist and status is 'active', it is created.
Requires list_id and subscriber_hash as path parameters.
Idempotency-Key header should be used with the Stripe charge ID to ensure safe retries.
No pagination supported; single request modifies tags.
Bearer token authentication using Mailchimp API key.
